{
  "rules": [
    "If sentiment is positive (≥ 0.20) in recent history, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next period.",
    "If model shows steady upward trend with no recent spike, but true outcome shows sharp rise, model is lagging; adjust forecast upward by 1–3% for next period.",
    "After a model forecast spike (e.g., >85), true outcome often corrects downward; apply downward bias of 2–5% for next 3–5 periods.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or negative (≤ 0.00), model often underestimates; increase forecast by 1–3% for next period.",
    "Model consistently overestimates in early periods of a new trend; apply mean reversion correction: if forecast > 85 and true < 82, reduce by 3–5%.",
    "If model forecast is flat or slightly rising but true outcome shows strong upward movement, model is underreacting; increase forecast by 2–4% for next period.",
    "If sentiment history shows recent positive spikes, model tends to overshoot; apply downward correction of 1–3% for next 2–3 periods."
  ]
}
